provenance.notes: Illustrative example written from general knowledge for schema review. Not derived from any source summary; not a gold label. Shows a low-confidence blueprint.

safe_text.logline: A self-satisfied TV weatherman sent to cover a small-town festival wakes up to find he is living the same day again, and again.
safe_text.protagonist: A sarcastic, self-absorbed local TV weather presenter who thinks the assignment is beneath him.
safe_text.setting: A small Pennsylvania town in winter, on one repeating day.
safe_text.central_conflict: How to escape a day that will not end, when nothing he does carries over.

spoiler_text.resolution: After exhausting indulgence and despair, he turns the endless day toward helping people and becoming someone worth loving, and only then does time move on.

safe_text.rationale: The protagonist begins emotionally closed off and trapped in a state he cannot escape by force.

spoiler_text.rationale: His release comes only through inner change, the core of Rebirth. A romance kept apart by his own behavior resolves in union, a Comedy thread.

safe_text.rationale: An unwilling hero is pulled out of his routine into a strange situation, though he never physically leaves town.

spoiler_text.rationale: The descent into despair works as an ordeal and his changed self as a return, but the mentor and threshold stages are missing, so the fit is loose.

safe_text.rationale: A comfortable, if smug, starting point drops sharply once the repetition begins.

spoiler_text.rationale: A brief hedonistic lift does not change the downward trend, which bottoms out in despair before a steady climb to the happiest point at the end.

evidence.time_loop: The same day restarts every morning and only he remembers it.
evidence.redemption_arc: He goes from contempt for the town to using each day to help its people.
